public function balanced(text: Text) returns Boolean
  purpose: Whether every round and square bracket is closed by its partner in the right order.
  tags: parsing, brackets
  example: balanced("(a[b])") is true
  example: balanced("(]") is false
  example: balanced("((") is false
  example: balanced("a]") is false
  example: balanced("") is true

  let mutable stack be empty()
  for each character in text.characters()
    if character is "(" then
      set stack to push(stack: stack, item: character)
    otherwise if character is "[" then
      set stack to push(stack: stack, item: character)
    otherwise if character is ")" then
      let top be peek(stack) otherwise return false
      if top is "(" then
        ignore pop(stack)
      otherwise
        return false
      end
    otherwise if character is "]" then
      let top be peek(stack) otherwise return false
      if top is "[" then
        ignore pop(stack)
      otherwise
        return false
      end
    end
  end

  return stack.is_empty()
end

public function balanced(text: Text) returns Boolean
  purpose: Whether every round and square bracket is closed by its partner in the right order.
  tags: parsing, brackets
  example: balanced("(a[b])") is true

    otherwise if character is "[" then
      set stack to push(stack: stack, item: character)
    otherwise if character is ")" then
      let top be peek(stack) otherwise return false
      if top is "(" then
        let popped be pop(stack) otherwise return false
        set stack to popped.rest
      otherwise
        return false
      end
    otherwise if character is "]" then
      let top be peek(stack) otherwise return false

```renyi
public function balanced(text: Text) returns Boolean
  purpose: Whether every round and square bracket is closed by its partner in the right order.
  tags: parsing, brackets
  example: balanced("(a[b])") is true
  example: balanced("(]") is false
  example: balanced("((") is false
  example: balanced("a]") is false
  example: balanced("") is true

  let mutable open_brackets be empty()
  let mutable ok be true

  for each ch in text.characters()
    if ch is "(" or ch is "[" then
      set open_brackets to push(stack: open_brackets, item: ch)
    otherwise if ch is ")" then
      let top be peek(open_brackets)
      if top is "(" then
        ignore pop(open_brackets)
      otherwise
        set ok to false
      end
    otherwise if ch is "]" then
      let top be peek(open_brackets)
      if top is "[" then
        ignore pop(open_brackets)
      otherwise
        set ok to false
      end
    end
  end

  return ok and open_brackets.is_empty()
end
```
